explication: Kilo Code is an AI coding agent exposed through VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI interfaces. A typical task starts with a user request, uses an agent and selected model to inspect or change a project, and can run commands and self-check its work. The repository also includes autocomplete, code review, indexing, and cloud/gateway capabilities. The README documents the product workflow and capabilities; source excerpts are limited, so internal runtime connections not shown there are left unverified rather than inferred.
